items.title: IBP for Healthcare
items.description: Medical device and healthcare technology companies operating under stringent regulatory compliance and complex global operations requirements.
challenges: Fragmented sales organizations with low demand visibility
solutions: Clear demand generation process, key account sales planning
Portfolio rationalization, enhanced demand planning, inventory optimizer
Automated regulatory documentation and compliance workflows

items.title: Precision Manufacturing
items.description: High-precision manufacturers requiring stringent quality controls, long processing and supply lead-times, and robust traceability.
challenges: Quality consistency achieving Six Sigma levels across all production lines
Long supply lead-times require very low demand forecasting errors
Complex portfolio increases risk of Excess & Obsolete
solutions: Portfolio rationalization and SKU life-cycle management
Production planning optimization linking demand, capacity, and quality metrics
Aligned Order Policy with Supply Policy, with necessary stock buffers

items.title: Consumer Packaged Goods
items.description: CPG enterprises managing complex brand portfolios, omnichannel distribution, and rapidly changing consumer preferences.
challenges: Portfolio segmentation across markets and channels
Omnichannel fulfillment complexity causing 15-20% margin erosion
Demand signal disruption due to evolving consumer habits
solutions: Portfolio strategy deployment with category-specific KPIs and market alignment
Category planning integration with supply chain and financial optimization
Higher capacity utilization, optimal inventory levels

items.title: Defense & Aerospace
items.description: Aerospace and defense contractors managing long-cycle programs with stringent quality, security, and compliance requirements.
challenges: Program milestone delays averaging 6–12 months due to coordination gaps
Quality control complexity across multi-tier supplier networks
Security compliance integration across engineering and supply chain operations
solutions: Program management integration with strategic milestone tracking and risk mitigation

items.title: FMCG
items.description: FMCG manufacturers managing perishable supply chains, short-cycle sales leading to highly dynamic demand signal, and complex regulatory requirements.
challenges: Demand volatility causing 30–40% forecast accuracy gaps in seasonal products
Perishable inventory management with 5–15% waste rates across supply chain
Raw Material inventory prone to commodity price fluctuations, impacting profitability
solutions: Advanced demand sensing with weather, seasonality, and promotional integration
Real-time cold chain optimization and inventory lifecycle management
Enhanced Raw Material long-range planning and stocking policies

story.title: Our Story
story.paragraph1: CreateDeliverCapture Consultancy was founded by Fortune 500 executives with over 100 years of combined experience at leading companies including Honeywell, Philips, and Eaton.
story.paragraph2: Having witnessed firsthand the challenges enterprises face in today's rapidly evolving business landscape, we recognized the need for a different approach—one that combines strategic thinking with operational excellence.
story.paragraph3: Our proprietary flow-based methodologies (FB-SD, FB-IBPE, FB-DRPE) are the result of decades of real-world experience transforming complex organizations across diverse industries.

roi.title: Our mission is to increase the ROI of your enterprise
items: CreateDeliverCapture is a small, focused advisory practice built around depth, not scale.
Founded by experienced executives, our firm brings deep sector knowledge and a hands-on approach to every engagement.
We partner with business leaders to uncover opportunities, streamline operations, and accelerate growth.
We work with a select number of clients to ensure focus, quality, and measurable results.
Every project is led by experienced consultants who stay involved from strategy through execution.
We work closely with clients to design and deliver solutions that improve performance, strengthen capability, and create lasting value.

problem.label: Why transformation stalls
problem.title: Most companies do not lack strategy. They lack execution clarity.
problem.description: Value is usually trapped between fragmented processes, underused systems, unclear ownership and weak performance routines. Our engagement model is designed to find that value quickly, prioritise it commercially and capture it through execution.
